g.text: One row per release, ordered by release date (oldest at top); 0 = release date
Ubuntu release life cycles aligned on each release date
Aligned on release, interim releases all share one short life of 9-19 months of standard support, while LTS releases get a median 5.0 years of standard support and, in
recent releases, ESM and legacy add-ons stretching to a median 15 years in total.
Dark vertical tick: today (2026-11-04); bars to its right are planned (future) dates; drawn only for releases still in their life cycle. Data: distro-info-data (ubuntu.csv).
